patch_description: Crossover of the three implementations: keep the current program's best idea — robust (Huber-reweighted) weighted local regression evaluated at the window's most recent sample (t=0), which yields excellent correlation (0.92), low lag (0.30) and low avg error (0.32) — and upgrade the local model from linear to degree-2 (from the first program's Savitzky-Golay center-evaluation), so curvature in the non-stationary signal is tracked without lag. Key improvements: (1) quadratic basis [t², t, 1] fit at t=0 via weighted normal equations, still zero-lag since we evaluate at the window end; (2) one Huber reweighting pass to suppress noise-induced false reversals; (3) a light 3-tap post-smoothing pass on the output to reduce spurious slope changes without adding meaningful phase delay; (4) sliding-window reuse of the input array with precomputed time/weight vectors for efficiency. The input/output interface (adaptive_filter, enhanced_filter_with_trend_preservation, process_signal) is unchanged.
